coreResponsibility.summary: A PlayKit JS plugin that provides cue point management and synchronization for the Kaltura Player, enabling time-based metadata display and interaction for both VOD and live streaming content.

featureOwnership: Cue point type registration and lifecycle management
Slide/thumbnail cue point handling for video navigation
Chapter marker management for content segmentation
Quiz question cue point synchronization for interactive video
Hotspot cue point support for in-video interactions
View change cue point tracking for multi-camera/layout switching
Q&A cue point support (public, user-specific, and code-based)
Real-time push notification handling for live streams
Simulive (simulated live) cue point offset calculation
DVR and live edge cue point timing adjustments
dataHandling: CuePoint objects with id, startTime, endTime, and metadata
CuepointTypeMap for registered cue point type tracking
Active cue point state management via CuepointEngine
Cue point snapshot and delta calculation for time-based updates
ID3 tag timestamp parsing for live stream synchronization
Push notification message parsing and transformation
Thumb asset URL resolution and caching
Pending cue point queue management for seekbar prevention mode
